description: Scaffold, truth and the hoistway: the pure model with tests, the layout/camera module, recorder-bound helpers adapted from the arcade-cabinet build, the concrete hoistway with floor slabs and C160 common bracket beams, all four guide rails with brackets, placeholder car and counterweight boxes that ride 'travel', the card, both themes, the audit hook over travel states, and a minimal live.js that moves car and CWT from the model with per-frame depth re-sort. This is the 'working page in the first hour' milestone; later FEATs deepen it. Design source: plan.md sections 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 9 and items 1-28 of section 4.
steps: Read plan.md in full, then SKILL.md and craft.md sections 3-8, kit.md sections 1-12, motion.md, and arcade-cabinet build.mjs + live.js. Raptor live.js place() (~line 144) is the re-sort pattern.

Create ROOT\model.mjs exactly as plan.md section 2: SPEC, TRAVEL, floorPos, plan (7-segment S-curve, vPeak solved for short runs), sample, doorAt, derived (cwtPos = TRAVEL - carPos, ropeSpeed = 2|v|, sheaveRpm, inverterHz, angles from position, govRpm, floor/atFloor, load, door state, loopPos), and the pure controller (initial, call, step, board) plus TOUR. No imports, no Date/Math.random.

Create ROOT\model.test.mjs with node:test covering the 5 property groups in plan.md section 2 (targets reached, jerk/accel/speed limits and continuity sampled at 1 ms over every from/to pair, run times 5.067 s and 13.47 s, carPos+cwtPos==TRAVEL and 119.37 rpm / 19.89 Hz / 95.49 rpm at rated, controller never moves with doors open, serves all calls, deterministic).

Create ROOT\layout.mjs: units cm; W=520, H=1040; P = k.fitProjection(envelope corners, 520, 1040, { pad: 26, azimuth: 50, elevation: 30 }); V = G.viewOf(P); every plan and z value from plan.md section 3 tables (shaft 0..180 x 0..235, Lf = 120 + 280(f-1), roof 1600, rails, beams, CWT, T, C, S_near/S_far from tangents with d-hat computed from the two rising points, hitches, governor, travelling cable, landing entrance, LCP, buffers); TRAVEL_CM = 1120; console.assert the clearances listed there.

Create ROOT\lib\helpers.mjs exporting makeHelpers(R, P) adapted from arcade build.mjs lines 41-170 (put, record, prismPaths, box, slab, prism, turned, disc, ball, planeMatrix, cable/route) plus: put() accepts group, ride, move and emits them on the item; ropeSlide(name, top, bottom, r, { ride, move, group }) draws one full-length tubePieces chunk (rest length + 1120 stroke beyond the fixed end) inside <clipPath><path data-hold d=clip/></clipPath> and records A.slide(G.frameAlong(top, down), 0, restLength, r); face(o, ex, ey, inner) returns a face-plane <g transform=matrix(...)>.

Create ROOT\parts\shaft.mjs (plan.md section 4 items 1-18): pit slab, back walls x0 and y0 (formwork joints edge to edge as the slab's inner, tie-hole dots), cut faces, the five L-shaped floor slabs and the roof stub via k.extrude(..., { convex:false }) recorded with A.extruded, the overhead hitch beam, the five C160 common bracket beams (web + flanges) with end bearing plates, sill support angles, shaft lights. Ground shapes are named 'stand.*' (pit slab, walls).

Create ROOT\parts\rails.mjs (items 19-28): car rails at x=100 on both sides (T89 extruded along z, foot + blade), CWT rails 1 and 2 (T50) at x=80, base plates on the pit floor, wall brackets (y0), clips on the beams (y1 car rail near flange, CWT rail 1 far flange), CWT rail 2 brackets on the y1 slab edges, fishplates at the 500 cm joints, bolt dots with rings. Rail tops: y1 car rail and CWT rail 1 at 1530 (they carry the machine bedplate in FEAT-002), y0 rail 1560, CWT rail 2 1520.

Add placeholder moving parts: a car box (cab outer plan, platform to roof) with piece 'car', ride 'travel', move [0,0,1120], and a CWT box (plan.md CWT plan, 280 tall, bottom at 1200 at rest) with piece 'cwt', ride 'travel', move [0,0,-1120]. They are replaced in FEAT-002.

Create ROOT\build.mjs: flags --light, --audit, --open (accepted now, used in FEAT-003); R = A.recorder(P, { order: ['travel'], spring: {} }); H = makeHelpers(R, P); call parts builders; A.settle(R, P, { states: A.uniformStates(56) }); sort; emit per item; figureSvg with a true label; plateHtml with Fig 1, title 'Anatomy of an MRL traction elevator', hint, readout, keys, caption draft, body = stage div (tabindex 0, role group, aria-label) + a

part/status line; pageHtml with script kitScript() + model.mjs (export stripped) + live.js (__DATA__ replaced with { P, V, EX, EY, EZ (k.axisVector for each axis), TRAVEL_CM, SPEC-derived data }); write mrl-elevator.html or mrl-elevator-light.html next to build.mjs; log a 'wrote' line; A.auditOrExit(R, P, { frames: A.uniformStates(112), apart: true }).
Create ROOT\mrl.css (inlined by build.mjs): cut-face token, part line, focus ring, selection tones ([data-on]/[data-focus] as in the Raptor CSS). Every colour is a token with light and dark values.

Create a minimal ROOT\live.js: read the nodes (data-k, data-m, data-ride), lift = m·V; rAF loop with dt clamped to 1/30 s that steps the model controller, sets share = carPos/TRAVEL, translates moving nodes (screen offset = m projected * share), re-sorts by key + lift*share re-appending only on change, writes the readout 'L1 ▲ 0.00 m/s · rope 0.00 m/s · 0 rpm' from derived(), keys 1-5 call floors, IntersectionObserver start/stop, reduced motion jumps. This is enough to see the car and CWT move opposite.
Run the verification commands, then open and read shots\desk-light.png and the motion shots. Fix anything wrong (composition 55-65 % fill, no part touching the corner labels).
acceptance_criteria: node --test model.test.mjs passes every test (from ROOT).
node build.mjs; node build.mjs --light writes ROOT\mrl-elevator.html and ROOT\mrl-elevator-light.html without exceptions.
node build.mjs --light --audit ends with the line 'audit passed'.
A capture with --key 5 --times 2000,8000 shows the car higher and the CWT lower than at rest, with the readout speed non-zero mid-run; no console errors are printed.
findings:
FILES CREATED: model.mjs, model.test.mjs, layout.mjs, lib/helpers.mjs, info.mjs (stub: INFO {shaft,rails,car,cwt} -> {name,text}), parts/shaft.mjs, parts/rails.mjs, parts/placeholders.mjs (car + CWT boxes with 4 guide shoes each on the rail blade tips; DELETE/replace in FEAT-002 and drop its import in build.mjs), build.mjs, live.js, mrl.css. Generated: mrl-elevator.html, mrl-elevator-light.html, shots/desk-light.png, run*.png, lines-*.png.

RESULTS: node --test model.test.mjs 7/7 pass. Build log: 'wrote mrl-elevator-light.html 341 KB · 187 items · 205 solids · scale 0.597'. Audit summary: 'audit · 0 tubes · 205 solids · 187 items · 57 depth states · 40615 overlaps · 1039 order rules · 34.7 s' then 'audit passed' (all lines 0). lines.mjs light and dark: 'line ends: 0'. Capture --key 5 --times 2000,8000: car climbs, CWT descends, readout 'L4 ▲ 1.00 m/s · rope 2.00 m/s · 119 rpm', console clean.

MODEL (model.mjs, pure): SPEC, TRAVEL (11.2 m), PERSON_KG 75, CWT_MASS 1015, floorPos(f), plan(from,to) positions in metres -> {from,to,dir,d,vPeak,tj,ta,tc,total,segs}, sample(plan,t) -> {pos,v,a,j,phase}, doorAt(t,phase), derived(state) -> {carPos,cwtPos,speed,dir,travelDir,ropeSpeed,sheaveRpm,inverterHz,sheaveAngle,carPulleyAngle,cwtPulleyAngle,govAngle,govRpm,govTripSpeed,floor,atFloor,persons,loadKg,loadPct,door,doorState,phase,loopPos}, readout(d) and status(d) (the card readout and the part/status line strings), controller initial(floor)/call(state,floor,kind)/step(state,dt)/board(state,n) (state: {t,pos,v,a,phase,floor,target,dir,motion,calls:{car,up,down},doorState,doorT,door,persons}; board only when doorState==='open' and resets dwell), TOUR [{at,floor,kind,board}] + TOUR_LENGTH 74 + tourEvent(state,event). In the page the model is inlined as an IIFE: global M = { SPEC, TRAVEL, floorPos, plan, sample, doorAt, derived, readout, status, initial, call, step, board, TOUR, TOUR_LENGTH, tourEvent } (add names to the return list in build.mjs modelScript if you export more). live.js is also wrapped in an IIFE.

HELPERS (lib/helpers.mjs) makeHelpers(R, P, defaults?) -> { put(name, ref, svg, shapes, {bias, piece, group, ride, move, owner, ...rest}), record, prismPaths(F,poly,s0,s1), prism(name,F,poly,s0,s1,style,{extra,inner,bias,ref,...}), box(name,[x0,y0,z0],[x1,y1,z1],style,{r=0.4,steps=2,bevel,extra,inner,bias,ground,...}), slab(name,plan,z,h,style,opts), extruded(name,ring,z,h,style,{extra,inner,bevel,ref,...}) (k.extrude convex:false + A.extruded), turned(name,F,profile,style,{smooth,steps,rims,bevel,owner,...}), disc(name,F,s0,s1,r,style,opts), ball(name,c,r,style,opts), planeMatrix(o,ex,ey), face(o,ex,ey,inner) -> '<g transform=matrix>', cable(name,points,r,{tone,bend,ends,shells,rings,maxLength,bias,limp,touch,bundle,...}), route(name,points,r,opts) (R.route with piece/move/ride defaults), ropeSlide(name, top, bottom, r, {ride, move, group, tone='hi', stroke=1120, bias, owner}) (one tubePieces chunk from top-stroke*down to bottom, clip from G.rodOut(F,0,rest,r,P,{stroke}).clip with data-hold, unique clipPath ids, records A.slide(G.frameAlong(top,down),0,rest,r)), scope(moreDefaults) -> same helpers with e.g. {piece:'car', ride:'travel', move:[0,0,1120]}, at, S, Ln, Dots, Faded, path3, V, KS, P, R, cables }. Every item gets piece (default 'shaft'), group (= piece unless given), ride, move. Ground = names starting 'stand.' (stand.pit, stand.wall.x0, stand.wall.y0).

BUILD: R = A.recorder(P,{order:['travel'],spring:{}}); parts each export build(H, L) with L = layout namespace; A.settle(R,P,{states:A.uniformStates(56)}); items emitted as <g class="it" data-name data-group data-k(3 dp) data-m="mx,my,mz" [data-ride="travel"]> inside <g class="mrl-layer">; page wrapper <div class="mrl"> (CSS tokens live on .mrl, dark override .iso[data-theme=dark] .mrl); stage div.iso-stage.mrl-stage (tabindex 0, role group) holds the svg and span.mrl-sr[data-live]; p.mrl-info[data-info] under it. DATA = {P,V,EX,EY,EZ,TRAVEL_CM,travel,floors}. --open flag parsed (const OPEN) but unused yet. A.auditOrExit(R,P,{frames:A.uniformStates(112),apart:true}) — add crowd: CROWD_OK when needed. Audit takes ~35 s now. NOTE: the execute tool's terminal output is unreliable here; run commands via cmd /c "... > shots\x.log 2>&1" (background for long ones) and read the log files.

LIVE (live.js): nodes from .mrl-layer .it; moving = data-ride travel; share = carPos/TRAVEL; translate = (EX*mx+EY*my+EZ*mz)*share, holdStill on nodes containing [data-hold]; re-sort by key + lift*share, re-append only on change; readout/status via M.readout/M.status; keys 1-5 -> M.call(state,n,'car'); IntersectionObserver start/stop; reduced motion jumps runs; loop stops when idle.

LAYOUT CHANGES vs plan.md: (1) rail sections use true sizes: T89 height 6.2 (foot 8.9, footT 1.0, blade 1.6), T50 height 5.0 (foot 5.0, footT 0.8, blade 0.5); tips are therefore car y0 14.2, car y1 143.8, CWT1 162.0, CWT2 219.0 (cab centred exactly between car tips at y 79). (2) WALL_Y0 = {x:0,y:-20,w:180,d:20} (starts at x 0 so it doesn't overlap wall x0). Walls run z 0..1625 standing on the pit slab; PIT_SLAB plan {x:-20,y:-20,w:200,d:255} z -25..0. (3) Slab stubs widened for composition: LOBBY_X 275, SIDE_Y 320 (SLAB_RING uses them); width use ~46 %, height ~80 %, nothing near the corner labels. (4) BEAM x 1.5..178.5 (plates 1.5 thick on wall x0 face and on the lobby slab edge x 178.5..180, the latter reaching to Lf-20 to touch the slab edge). HITCH_BEAM x 1.5..178.5, y 200..214, z 1580..1600 as I-section (flanges 1.5, web 1.2 centred y 207). (5) Rail cuts at z 500/1000/1500 (only below top-10), base plates z 0..2 (RAIL_BASE 2). Sill angles at x 176..180, y 31..127, top at Lf-3 (the landing sill should sit on z Lf-3). Shaft lights on wall y0 at x 34..46, z Lf+150..166. CWT2 slab brackets occupy y 222.4..235, z Lf-24..Lf-2; y0 wall brackets y 0..9.6, z Lf-41..Lf-25. layout.mjs also already holds T, C, S_NEAR, S_FAR (from tangents, D_HAT from the two rising points), HITCH_A/B, MOTOR, BEDPLATE, GOVERNOR, TENSION, TAPE, CABLE, ENTRANCE, HALL, INDICATOR, LCP, buffers, LADDER, with console.asserts on clearances (all hold).
